How leave accrues Paid, casual, and sick leave are credited at the start of the calendar year. Earned leave accrues monthly based on days worked. Balances are pro-rated for mid-year joiners from your date of joining.
Applying for leave Apply at least 3 working days in advance via Apply for leave above. Requests route to your manager for approval. Sick leave of 3+ consecutive days requires a medical certificate uploaded to Documents.
Carry-forward & encashment Up to 10 unused paid-leave days carry forward to the next year. Earned leave is encashable at exit per your full-and-final settlement. Casual and sick leave lapse at year end and are not encashable.
The official holiday calendar is maintained in Time Off → Configuration → Public Holidays. Gazetted holidays are mandatory; restricted holidays are optional.
Everything you need to know about working hours, leaves, and time off at Ethara.

Standard working hours are 9:30–18:30, Monday to Friday. Ethara provides four leave types — paid, casual, sick, and earned — accrued and applied through the rules below. Read the policy precisely, then apply through GreytHR.
A full working day is 9.0 hours. Days under the half-day threshold (clock-out before 13:00) are recorded as half-day. Mark Absent days as worked via regularization.

Paid leave — Credited at the start of the calendar year. Casual leave — For short, planned personal time. Lapses at year end. Sick leave — 3+ consecutive days need a medical certificate. Earned leave — Accrues monthly, encashable at exit.

Maternity (182 days), paternity (15 days), bereavement (5 days), and comp-off for approved weekend work are granted over and above your annual entitlement, subject to eligibility and statutory limits.
Does a holiday between two leave days count as leave? Yes — the sandwich rule applies; an intervening holiday or week-off between leave days is counted as leave.

Applying for leave: Apply at least 3 working days in advance. Requests route to your manager for approval. Sick leave of 3+ consecutive days requires a medical certificate uploaded to Documents.
Carry-forward & encashment: Up to 10 unused paid-leave days carry forward to the next year. Earned leave is encashable at exit per your full-and-final settlement. Casual and sick leave lapse at year end.
